story.text: Sir John brings two new cousins to Barton Park, the Miss Steeles. Anne, the elder, talks of nothing but {BEAUX}; Lucy is pretty, sharp and {IGNORANT}. They win Lady Middleton by {ADORING} her spoilt children, laughing at all their {MISCHIEVOUS} tricks, even when the little ones pull their {HAIR}.
story.caption: Mischievous tricks
